text:
Nina: quick follow-up from the RFC: i think we should version the hw seed-sets and make them part of the bench metadata. reproducibility is getting messy.
Omar: agree. current problem: same seed produces different perf because bench host differs (a100 vs t4). versioning + hw-tagging would help the triage.
Priya: proposal: seed-set object = { id, hw_class, created_at, manifest_checksum, sample_count }. store id in bench run artifact.
Nina: yea, and make the sampling service pick seed-set by: 1) exact hw_class match, 2) manifest "preferred_hardware" list fallback, 3) global seed-set.
Omar: should we auto-generate seed-sets per hw class from live traffic? or hand-curate?
Priya: automated generation with manual review. a daily job harvests candidate inputs per hw class by stratified seqlen buckets, then operator approves/rotates.
Nina: costs: more seed-sets -> more bench permutations. mitigation: only run hw-specific smoke for targets that matter (dedicated, high-traffic models). otherwise run global smoke.
Omar: how do we record that a bench was "proxy" vs genuine? we need a flag.
BenchBot: NOTE: bench_run_metadata now accepts fields: seed_set_id, bench_hardware, seed_generation_method (auto/manual), is_cross_hw_proxy=true/false.
Priya: tooling: CLI to list seed-sets + show samples: `rbx seeds list --hw t4` and `rbx seeds show <id>`. useful for SE repro.
Nina: integration: add seed_set_id to evaluation artifacts so quality/regressions can be filtered by hw class. also include a human-readable note in rollout dashboards.
Omar: edgecases: new hw_class appears (e.g., newer GPUs). plan: create an "unknown" seed-set that is conservative, and schedule a harvest job to build an initial set. mark onboarding runs as experimental until seed set is approved.
Priya: small pseudocode for selection: 
```
preferred = manifest.preferred_hardware
if preferred contains host_hw: choose latest_seed(preferred, host_hw)
elif seed_exists(host_hw): choose latest_seed(host_hw)
else: choose global_seed()
```
Omar: monitoring: add bench_hardware tag to all perf dashboards and drift alerts so we don't compare apples to oranges.
Nina: timeline: i can PR the registry schema (preferred_hardware:list + seed_set_refs) today. Priya you ok to own the seed-store and harvest job?
Priya: yep, will prototype a small Postgres table + s3 bucket for sample payloads.
BenchBot: ACTION: Nina -> open registry schema PR; Priya -> spike seed-harvester; Omar -> add bench_hardware tag to perf dashboards.
Nina: thanks. i'll also put a short runbook on when to gate hw-aware smoke (traffic threshold + deployment target).
Omar: :thumbsup:
Priya: :rocket:
